statement: There are constants ε0 > 0 and C > 0 with the following property. Let F be a nonzero real solution of ΔF + qF = 0 on D3, q ∈ C∞ (D3), ∥q∥∞ < ε0. If β = log ∥F∥L∞(D5/2) ∥F∥L∞(D1/4) , then H1 (ZF ∩ D1/60) ≤ C max{1, β}.
